description: Hacker News Search & Stories: full-text search of Hacker News stories or comments (HN Search by Algolia). Per hit the title, text, author, points, comment count, linked URL, time and item URL in the shared social schema; next_cursor gives the next page. Tech news, launches and developer discussion for market and competitor research. Bad input is free; not found or no match is not charged. Price: $0.01 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].
